titulo: UPS (Jan 2026): $6.39 billion to shareholders, about 14,000 positions cut, completed 2025. The math.
caption:
From the archive: Jan 2026. Not today's news.
UPS, Jan 27, 2026 (UPS, Q4 2025 earnings release): "right-size our business to create a more efficient operating model"
UPS's fourth-quarter 2025 earnings release, dated January 27, 2026, describes a workforce reduction of approximately 14,000 positions, completed in 2025. Its 2025 10-K reports the stock purchases and dividends listed here, in millions.

Same year: $6.39 billion to shareholders, 2025, company-wide. $1,000 million of stock repurchased plus $5,398 million of dividends in 2025, company-wide (cash flow statement, Form 10-K, in millions; columns are 2025, 2024, 2023).
The math: $6.39 billion to shareholders, 2025, company-wide ÷ about 14,000 positions = $457,000 in buybacks and dividends per job cut.
The facts: $6.39 billion to shareholders, 2025, company-wide (UPS 2025 10-K (SEC), Feb 17, 2026). about 14,000 positions cut, completed 2025 (UPS Q4 2025 release (SEC), Jan 27, 2026). The $6.4 billion adds UPS's 2025 stock purchases ($1.0 billion) and dividends ($5.4 billion), from its 10-K. The 14,000 positions is UPS's own approximate figure, from its earnings release. Both figures are for 2025.

Efficient, for whom? (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: UPS Q4 2025 release (SEC), Jan 27, 2026; UPS 2025 10-K (SEC), Feb 17, 2026.

Tap the link in bio.
